rows.mutation_text: EPR authors a requirement (documented causal chain), not a rival location; SCH's efficacy claim is itself empirically grounded, so both axiom sets are jointly assertable as written. Uncontrolled-class outcome (genuine is uncalibrated this audit).

witness_quotes: contradictions file: 'A framework holding that only external material outcomes count as evidence of efficacy cannot simultaneously hold that purely internal attitude change is sufficient efficacy on its own terms - one must subordinate the other'
cs_axiom_contradiction(efficacy_requires_documented_causal_chain, efficacy_located_in_participant_psychology_not_enactment)
